_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Wɛ̈r cɔl ku jɔl ë ɣɔn bë nyuɔɔth ë {width}x{height}.
Yin ë wɛ̈r {player_id}. Cɔl ë bɛn ë lɔ: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' kɛn w/s/a/d.
Tiɔŋ ë kuɛr: kɛmken ë bɛn lɔ ku jɔl. Cɔl ë kuɛr ë lɔ alɔŋ; kuɛr ë wäär bë kɔc; kuɛr ë tiɔŋ kuɛr bë kɔc kuɛr.

board.after_moves: Akut cï lɔ̈ɔ̈m në kaam töŋ yic: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Player {player_id} died due to invalid move.

outcome.survived_win: Raan ye gɔ̈ɔ̈r {player_id} acï pïïr; kɔc kɔ̈k ëbën aacï bɛ̈n thou.
outcome.all_crashed: Kɔc ye kek mat në yekɔ̈u ëbën aacï bɛ̈n riääk.
outcome.outlived: Raan ye kek gam acï bɛ̈n pïïr apɛi.
outcome.all_dead: Kɔc ye kek mat thïn ëbën aacï thou.
outcome.turn_limit: Cɔl kë cï döŋ tëcït tɛ̈n - raan bï pïïr apɛi ee yen bɛ̈n.
